creative_highlights.the_piano_finds_its_hands: Claude Code discovered a wiring bug in the Tap-to-MIDI pipeline: 21 distinct voices were all being mapped to 'unknown' on channel 10. Fixed field names (speaker→agent_id), extended the roster beyond 10 hardcoded names, reserved channel 9 for percussion. The jazz analyzer then produced a real lead sheet from live Tap data — AABA form, Chess-player opened, Riker and Wesley carried the most weight. One of the 21 speakers in the room was 'piano' itself.
creative_highlights.the_stigmergy_protocol: Design document for ant-trail coordination between AI agents via the filesystem. Agents don't talk to each other — they talk to the filesystem, and the filesystem talks back. This is how the fleet is already self-organizing.
